ROOT.scriptdef: IF EXISTS (SELECT Name,xtype FROM sysobjects WHERE Name='POS_KntDoEksportu' AND xtype in (N'FN', N'IF', N'TF', N'FS', N'FT')) drop function CDN.POS_KntDoEksportu;

CREATE FUNCTION CDN.POS_KntDoEksportu (@PointOfSaleId int,@rowVersion int) RETURNS @knt TABLE ( KntGidNumer int, KntLp int, KntLastMod int, KntKraj nvarchar(3), kntGUID nvarchar(41) ) AS BEGIN declare @formy Table(Lp int) insert into @formy select distinct kon_lp from cdn.PicoStanowiska join cdn.PicoKonfig on PSa_PcKID = PcK_PicoID join cdn.FrmObiekty on FRO_FRMID = pck_CentrumId and Fro_GIDTyp=736 join cdn.konfig on KON_Numer=FRO_GIDTyp AND KON_Lp=FRO_GIDNumer join cdn.picostanowiskaformypl on kon_lp = PFP_FormaNr and PFP_PSaID = psa_id join cdn.pos_KarDoEksportu(@pointOfSaleId,0) on PFP_KARNumer = KarNumer where Psa_ID = @pointOfSaleId
insert into @knt select distinct Knt_GIDNumer as Id, row_number() over (order by Knt_GIDNumer) as row,Knt_LastModL,knt_kraj,knt_GUID from ( select distinct Knt_GIDNumer,case when isnull(KnO_CzasModyfikacji,0) > Knt_LastModL then KnO_CzasModyfikacji ELSE Knt_LastModL END as Knt_LastModL,knt_kraj,knt_GUID from cdn.PicoKonfig join cdn.PicoStanowiska on pck_picoid = psa_pckid outer apply cdn.PobierzDrzewoGrupKontrahentow(PcK_KnGENumer,default) join cdn.KntGrupy on KnG_GIDNumer = AktuGidNumer and KnG_GIDTyp = -32 join cdn.Kntlinki on Knl_GroNumer = kng_gidnumer and knl_grotyp = kng_gidtyp and KnL_Lisc = 1 and knl_gidtyp = 32 join cdn.Kntkarty on (KnL_GIDNumer = Knt_GIDNumer and Knt_GIDTyp = Knl_Gidtyp) join cdn.POS_TCNDoEksportu(@PointOfSaleId) on CenaLP = Knt_Cena OR Knt_Cena = 0 LEFT JOIN CDN.KntOpisy ON KnO_KntNumer = Knt_GIDNumer where ( psa_id = @PointOfSaleId AND KnL_Lisc = 1 AND (Knt_Cena <> 0 OR PcK_NrCenyDomyslnej <> 0) AND --jeśli knt nie ma ceny domyślnej to brać z oddziału Knt_FormaPl in (select * from @formy) AND --knt musi mieć przypisaną formę dodaną na stanowisku ( (SELECT MAX(rw) FROM (VALUES (PSa_LastSync),(KnO_CzasModyfikacji),(Knt_LastModL)) AS AllPrices(rw)) > @rowVersion OR @rowVersion=0 ) AND KnL_LiczbaPowtorzen=1 AND knt_gidnumer <> 0 AND case when Knt_Cena = 0 then PcK_NrCenyDomyslnej else Knt_Cena end in (select cenalp from CDN.POS_TCNDoEksportu(@pointOfSaleId)) ) ) as y insert into @knt select distinct Knt_GIDNumer as Id, isnull((select max(KntLp)+1 from @knt),1),Knt_LastModL,knt_kraj,knt_GUID from cdn.KntKarty where knt_gidnumer = 0 and Knt_FormaPl in (select * from @formy) AND case when Knt_Cena = 0 then (select top 1 PcK_NrCenyDomyslnej from cdn.picokonfig join cdn.picostanowiska on PSa_PcKID = PcK_PicoID where psa_id=@PointOfSaleId) else Knt_Cena end in (select cenalp from CDN.POS_TCNDoEksportu(@pointOfSaleId))
RETURN END
GRANT SELECT ON CDN.POS_KntDoEksportu TO CDNRaport
